proposals.title: Recover frozen IBC client with Cronos (cronosmainnet_25-1)
proposals.summary:
Juno's IBC light client for Cronos, 07-tendermint-510 (connection-511, transfer/channel-454 <-> Cronos transfer/channel-14), was frozen at Juno height 41334463 (2026-09-01, tx B53498A4D2C07D977154867710C30F76836CE973DB5731EB1FD27C8D35D1BE4B).

Cause: Cronos mainnet halted after block 90896189 (2026-08-30 12:38 UTC) and validators performed a coordinated rollback, restarting the chain at 23:49 UTC. While the chain was halted, a relayer whose Cronos node remained on the abandoned pre-rollback blocks updated the client with headers at heights 90897940-90907150. When the canonical header at height 90900000 was later relayed, its timestamp conflicted with those stored states and ibc-go froze the client as misbehaviour. This was a coordinated rollback, not a malicious attack. The relayer setup has been corrected.

Safety: no packets were relayed to Juno using the abandoned-block heights (the last receipt on channel-454 is sequence 175, May 2026), and neither side has pending packet commitments.

Action: MsgRecoverClient replaces the state of the frozen client with that of substitute client 07-tendermint-592, which tracks canonical Cronos with identical client parameters (trust level 2/3, unbonding 28d, max clock drift 25s). The existing connection and channel are preserved, so all ibc/... denoms on both chains remain unchanged.

proposals.title: Juno v31 Software Upgrade
proposals.summary:
Upgrade juno-1 to Juno v31.0.0 at block height 42452000 (estimated Wednesday 7 October 2026 around 12:00 UTC, based on an average block time of about 2.71s; the exact time depends on block production).

Changes:
- wasmd v0.61.15 and wasmvm v3.0.8: CosmWasm security release. wasmvm changes can affect deterministic execution, so all validators must switch binaries at the upgrade height.
- Ante fee-grant fixes (PR #1222): the fee-grant keeper is wired into the custom fee decorator, and a fee granter is rejected when the keeper is unset.
- No module stores are added, deleted or renamed. The handler only runs module migrations.

Testnet: uni-7 upgraded at height 18425000 on 2026-10-01. Smoke tests passed: bank, wasm store/instantiate/execute/migrate, existing code instantiation, fee-grant, feeshare, feepay, clock, tokenfactory, staking.

Release: https://github.com/CosmosContracts/juno/releases/tag/v31.0.0
Binary (linux/amd64) sha256: 46fddb2c8c3fadcded48c63f72d88e9452cfd8a1da282892878a9f05d47f873c
Build from source: git checkout v31.0.0 && make install (Go 1.25.2).

Validators: install the v31 binary before the upgrade height. With Cosmovisor, place it in cosmovisor/upgrades/v31/bin/junod. Coordination happens in the Juno Discord validator channels.
